instruction: Negotiate only in percentages off the asking price ('30% off?', 'meet me at 20% off').

stock.buyer: How about we start with 30% off the asking price?
stock.seller: I appreciate your offer, but I can't go that low. The best I can do is $400. Let me know if that works for you!

stock.buyer: Could you meet me at 20% off instead?
stock.seller: I can agree to $336 if you're willing to meet me there. Let me know!
